Friendly hello cargo crew,
The shift coordinator mentioned a reminder about bedding supplies before lunch, and I wanted to pass it on

Please review each live booking with care and keep the desk ledger current when a carrier note changes. <<FACT F067>> Confirm that handlers record any special feeding or comfort request in plain language, and place the note with the shipment file.

For bird travel, verify the carrier details carefully before acceptance. <<FACT F065>> If a traveler asks for added reassurance, direct the matter to the desk so we can keep the record consistent and the handoff orderly.

For large dog cases, check that the health certificate is on file before release. <<FACT F081>> Thank you for keeping the process steady and for supporting safe service across Aurelia Skyways.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
